ursazoo-lanhu-to-code-code-format.description: Convert Lanhu HTML/CSS output into project frontend code for Vue, React, or the detected stack, with component reuse and design token mapping.

ursazoo-lanhu-to-code-code-gen.description: Extract Lanhu design HTML, CSS, and assets through Lanhu MCP for Claude Code design-to-code workflows. Called by design-to-code.

ursazoo-lanhu-to-code-component-doc-gen.description: Scan frontend src directories and generate docs/components.md so Claude Code can reuse existing Vue/React components during design-to-code generation.

ursazoo-lanhu-to-code-design-to-code.description: Lanhu to Code workflow for Claude Code. Convert Lanhu design URLs into Vue/React frontend code with component reuse, design token mapping, TODO-safe business logic, and optional code review.
